Why WeatherWalay App? 
The WeatherWalay App is designed to help you receive near perfect, accurate hyper local weather information provided by our deployed state of the art weather stations and the expert analyses of our professional weather forecasters and scientists.

Due to the highly dynamic climate, you might face the negative effects of climate change. Fortunately, our app will allow you to mitigate climate change related risks due to accurate hyper local weather information, helping you make better informed and planned decisions.
